# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by ConfigReferenceTest from ThrillhouseConfig.java and
     application.properties. Do not edit by hand; regenerate with
     ./mvnw test -Dtest=ConfigReferenceTest -Dconfig-reference.write=true -->

<!-- docs:config-reference:start -->
Every setting the bot reads, with the environment variable that sets it. A row shows the short alias `application.properties` defines for it where there is one; every `thrillhousebot.*` key also accepts its standard Quarkus name (the key in uppercase with each `.` and `-` replaced by `_`), which overrides the alias. What the features do is described in the README's [Configuration](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#configuration) section.

Durations take Quarkus' format (`10s`, `5m`, `24h`, or an ISO-8601 value such as `PT1M`). A list is comma-separated.

## Quarkus and LangChain4j settings

These variables set Quarkus and LangChain4j keys rather than a `thrillhousebot.*` key.

| Variable | Description | Default | Sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AI_API_KEY` | API key for the AI provider. Required. | _(none)_ | `quarkus.langchain4j.openai.api-key`<br>`quarkus.langchain4j.openai.concise.api-key` |
| `AI_BASE_URL` | OpenAI-compatible base URL of the AI provider. | `https://api.deepseek.com/v1` | `quarkus.langchain4j.openai.base-url`<br>`quarkus.langchain4j.openai.concise.base-url` |
| `AI_MODEL` | Chat model name. It also selects the model's entry in the per-model settings and the pricing map. | `deepseek-chat` | `quarkus.langchain4j.openai.chat-model.model-name`<br>`quarkus.langchain4j.openai.concise.chat-model.model-name` |
| `AI_TIMEOUT` | Per-request timeout of an AI call. | `300s` | `quarkus.langchain4j.openai.timeout`<br>`quarkus.langchain4j.openai.concise.timeout` |
| `DATABASE_URL` | JDBC URL of the production database (`jdbc:postgresql://db:5432/thrillhouse` in Docker Compose). | `%prod`: `jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/thrillhouse` | `quarkus.datasource.jdbc.url` |
| `DATASOURCE_DB_KIND` | `h2` or `postgresql`. Quarkus fixes this at build time, so released images are PostgreSQL builds and ignore `h2`. | `h2`; `%prod`: `postgresql` | `quarkus.datasource.db-kind` |
| `DS_INPUT_PRICE` | Price of 1,000 input tokens on `deepseek-chat`, in US dollars. | `0.00014` | `thrillhousebot.ai.pricing.deepseek-chat.input-per-1k` |
| `DS_OUTPUT_PRICE` | Price of 1,000 output tokens on `deepseek-chat`, in US dollars. | `0.00028` | `thrillhousebot.ai.pricing.deepseek-chat.output-per-1k` |
| `OTEL_EXPORTER_ENDPOINT` | OTLP endpoint traces are exported to. | `http://localhost:4317` | `quarkus.otel.exporter.otlp.traces.endpoint` |
| `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED` | Turn telemetry off: nothing is exported over OTLP and the Prometheus endpoint answers 404. | `false` | `quarkus.otel.sdk.disabled` |
| `PORT` | HTTP port the bot listens on (webhooks, dashboard, health and metrics). | `8080` | `quarkus.http.port` |
| `REVIEW_CONCISE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` | Response cap (`max_tokens`) for the calls on the `concise` model: the summary call, the verifier and replies. A summary cut at this cap is salvaged or replaced by a counts-only summary, and the findings are kept. Set it empty to send no cap. | `8192` | `quarkus.langchain4j.openai.concise.chat-model.max-tokens` |

## `thrillhousebot`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HTTP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`<br>`thrillhousebot.http-connect-timeout` | Outbound HTTP connect timeout (GitHub API, OAuth). | duration | `10s` |
| `HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT`<br>`thrillhousebot.http-request-timeout` | Outbound HTTP request timeout (GitHub API, OAuth). | duration | `10s` |
| `WEBSOCKET_KEEPALIVE_MS`<br>`thrillhousebot.websocket-keepalive-ms` | Dashboard WebSocket keepalive in milliseconds, so reverse proxies do not close idle connections. `0` or less disables it and stale replay-buffer eviction. | integer | `25000` |

## `thrillhousebot.ai`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| _(follows `quarkus.langchain4j.openai.base-url`)_<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.base-url` | The AI base URL, read from `AI_BASE_URL`; used to derive the telemetry provider when `AI_PROVIDER` is unset. Set `AI_BASE_URL` rather than this key. | string | `https://api.deepseek.com/v1` |
| `AI_MAX_CONCURRENT_CALLS`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.max-concurrent-calls` | Most model calls in flight at once across the process (review batches, summaries, the verifier, replies and commands). A call past it waits for a slot, up to `THRILLHOUSEBOT_REVIEW_AI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, and a wait over 5 seconds is logged at INFO. A provider's rate-limit or concurrent-slot refusal is retried after 30 seconds either way. `0` means no limit. | integer | `0` |
| `AI_PROVIDER`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.provider-name` | Provider label for telemetry (`gen_ai.provider.name`); derived from `AI_BASE_URL` when unset. | string | _(none)_ |

## `thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>`

Model-specific settings, keyed by the model name (the `AI_MODEL` value). Only the active model's entry is read, so you can keep entries for several models and switch `AI_MODEL` freely. Quote a model name that contains `.` or `/` (`thrillhousebot.ai.models."gpt-5.5".max-input-tokens`). From the environment, hyphen-only names use underscores (`THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_DEEPSEEK_V4_PRO_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=1000000`) and dotted names the quoted form (`THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS__GPT_5_5__MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=256000`); either needs an empty `max-input-tokens=` line for that model in `application.properties`, which ships one for the models it knows. See [Per-model AI settings](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#per-model-ai-settings).

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_CONTEXT_TOKENS`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.context-tokens` | The model's total context window. On a shared window the prompt and the completion are both charged to it, so boot fails when `max-input-tokens + max-output-tokens` does not fit inside it, or when the effective budget plus the largest response cap in play (`max-output-tokens` or `REVIEW_CONCISE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`) does not. Unset, the ceiling is not checked. | integer | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_FREQUENCY_PENALTY`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.frequency-penalty` | `frequency_penalty` sent on every chat call, in `[-2, 2]`. Positive values discourage repeating tokens in proportion to how often they already appeared. Unset keeps the provider default. | number | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.max-input-tokens` | Input-token cap for this model. The effective review budget is the smaller of `REVIEW_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS` and this cap; a model without one gets 128000. It is a cap, not the budget: to go beyond it on a large-context model, raise both. Startup logs a warning when the cap lowers the budget. | integer | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.max-output-tokens` | Response cap (`max_tokens`) sent on the review call and the command generators. `output-buffer-tokens` only reserves room in the input budget, so set both when you cap output. Unset leaves the provider default. | integer | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_OUTPUT_BUFFER_TOKENS`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.output-buffer-tokens` | This model's `REVIEW_OUTPUT_BUFFER_TOKENS`: tokens reserved from the input budget for the response. On a shared window it must be at least `max-output-tokens`, or boot fails. Ignored with `separate-output-budget` set. | integer | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_PRESENCE_PENALTY`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.presence-penalty` | `presence_penalty` sent on every chat call, in `[-2, 2]`. Positive values discourage repeating any token that already appeared. Unset keeps the provider default. | number | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_SEED`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.seed` | `seed` sent on every chat call, asking for repeatable sampling on providers that support it; others ignore it. For steadier reviews, lower `temperature` first. Unset sends no seed. | integer | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_SEPARATE_OUTPUT_BUDGET`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.separate-output-budget` | Set `true` only when the provider bills the response outside the context window (1M in with 384K out on top, rather than 384K carved out of the 1M). It switches off both the `output-buffer-tokens` reservation and the `context-tokens` ceiling. Getting it wrong is costly either way; check the provider's documented window first. | boolean | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_TEMPERATURE`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.temperature` | Sampling temperature sent on every chat call, in `[0, 2]`. Unset keeps the default (1.0). | number | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_TOKEN_SAFETY_MARGIN`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.token-safety-margin` | This model's `REVIEW_TOKEN_SAFETY_MARGIN`: the fraction of the input budget actually used, to absorb token-estimate error. | number | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_MODELS_<MODEL>_TOP_P`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.models.<model>.top-p` | Nucleus-sampling `top_p` sent on every chat call, in `(0, 1]`. Unset keeps the default (1.0). `top_k` is not part of the OpenAI-compatible API, so it cannot be set. | number | _(none)_ |

## `thrillhousebot.ai.pricing.<model>`

Prices used for cost tracking, keyed by model name (the `AI_MODEL` value) like the per-model settings. `application.properties` ships prices for the models it knows. When you change `AI_MODEL`, add a matching pair; without one, tokens are still recorded and the model's sessions are flagged "no pricing" in the dashboard instead of showing `$0`.

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_PRICING_<MODEL>_INPUT_PER_1K`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.pricing.<model>.input-per-1k` | Price of 1,000 input tokens, in US dollars. | number | _(none)_ |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_AI_PRICING_<MODEL>_OUTPUT_PER_1K`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.pricing.<model>.output-per-1k` | Price of 1,000 output tokens, in US dollars. | number | _(none)_ |

## `thrillhousebot.ai.reasoning`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AI_REASONING_EFFORT_CONCISE`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.reasoning.concise-effort` | Effort for the calls on the `concise` model (summary, verifier, replies), which do not follow `AI_REASONING_EFFORT`. Same values. Unset means `low`, or `AI_REASONING_EFFORT` when that is lower. | string | _(none)_ |
| `AI_REASONING_EFFORT`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.reasoning.effort` | Effort for the review and the on-demand commands: `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`. Reasoning tokens are billed as output. A provider that does not know a tier rejects the call. See [Per-model AI settings](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#per-model-ai-settings). | string | `low` |
| `AI_REASONING_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.ai.reasoning.enabled` | Send a reasoning-effort hint (`reasoning_effort`). When `false`, no reasoning parameter is sent and the provider default applies, except on the one repeat of a call that spent its whole output cap reasoning, which sends the lane's effort. | boolean | `false` |

## `thrillhousebot.dashboard`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_DASHBOARD_GITHUB_ACCOUNT_OWNER`<br>`thrillhousebot.dashboard.github.account-owner` | Optional. When set, the dashboard serves only the installation on this account. Unset serves every installation the signed-in user can access. Either way a user sees only the repositories GitHub lets them read. | string | _(none)_ |
| `GITHUB_CLIENT_ID`<br>`thrillhousebot.dashboard.github.client-id` | OAuth client ID for dashboard login, from the GitHub App's settings. Leave it and `GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET` unset to disable login. | string | _(none)_ |
| `GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET`<br>`thrillhousebot.dashboard.github.client-secret` | OAuth client secret for dashboard login, from the GitHub App's settings. | string | _(none)_ |
| `GITHUB_OAUTH_URL`<br>`thrillhousebot.dashboard.github.oauth-url` | Base URL of GitHub's OAuth endpoints. | string | `https://github.com/login/oauth` |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_DASHBOARD_GITHUB_REDIRECT_URI`<br>`thrillhousebot.dashboard.github.redirect-uri` | OAuth callback URL registered on the GitHub App; follows `DASHBOARD_URL`. | string | `${DASHBOARD_URL}/api/auth/callback` |
| `DASHBOARD_URL`<br>`thrillhousebot.dashboard.url` | Public dashboard URL, used for the OAuth callback and the session links posted to GitHub. | string | `http://localhost:8080` |

## `thrillhousebot.github`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GITHUB_APP_ID`<br>`thrillhousebot.github.app-id` | GitHub App ID, from the App's settings page. Required. | string | _(none)_ |
| `GITHUB_BOT_LOGINS`<br>`thrillhousebot.github.bot-logins` | Comma-separated bot logins the bot ignores so it never answers itself. Override when the App slug differs (`<app-slug>[bot]`). | list | `thrillhousebot[bot]`, `thrillhouse-bot[bot]` |
| `GITHUB_PRIVATE_KEY`<br>`thrillhousebot.github.private-key` | GitHub App private key (PEM), on one line with each newline written as `\n`, unquoted. Required. | string | _(none)_ |
| `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET`<br>`thrillhousebot.github.webhook-secret` | The GitHub App's webhook secret, used to check each delivery's HMAC signature. Required. | string | _(none)_ |
| `GITHUB_WRITE_MAX_WAIT`<br>`thrillhousebot.github.write-max-wait` | Longest one caller waits for its write slot before it goes out unpaced and the backoff handles any refusal. | duration | `90s` |
| `GITHUB_WRITE_MIN_INTERVAL`<br>`thrillhousebot.github.write-min-interval` | Minimum spacing between two content-creating GitHub calls (comments, review comments, replies, reviews), shared by the whole process. GitHub's guidance is at most one per second; it answers faster writes with `403`, `429` or a `422` "was submitted too quickly". When GitHub throttles a write anyway, every queued write waits with it. `0` disables pacing. | duration | `1s` |
| `GITHUB_WRITE_RETRY_BUDGET`<br>`thrillhousebot.github.write-retry-budget` | Longest one review may spend waiting on GitHub's rate limit across all its writes. Once spent, later throttled writes are not retried, and the review body names the findings they carried and asks for a re-run. `0` disables the limit. | duration | `5m` |

## `thrillhousebot.metrics`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PROMETHEUS_METRICS_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.metrics.prometheus-enabled` | Serves the OpenTelemetry metrics in Prometheus text format at `GET /metrics` on the main HTTP port, alongside the OTLP export. Off by default: the endpoint is unauthenticated, so shield it at the proxy before enabling it on internet-facing deployments. | boolean | `false` |

| `NOTIFICATIONS_WEBHOOK_EVENTS`<br>`thrillhousebot.notifications.webhook.events` | Comma-separated outcomes to send: `completed`, `failed`. | list | `completed`, `failed` |
| `NOTIFICATIONS_WEBHOOK_FORMAT`<br>`thrillhousebot.notifications.webhook.format` | Body format: `json` (the structured payload), `slack` or `discord` (an incoming-webhook message for that chat service). | string | `json` |
| `NOTIFICATIONS_WEBHOOK_INCLUDE_CONTENT`<br>`thrillhousebot.notifications.webhook.include-content` | Also send the PR title and each finding's severity, file, line and title. | boolean | `false` |
| `NOTIFICATIONS_WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS`<br>`thrillhousebot.notifications.webhook.max-attempts` | Attempts per notification (1–5). A timeout, connection failure, `429` or `5xx` is retried after 1, 2, 4 and 8 seconds, then dropped with a WARN. | integer | `3` |
| `NOTIFICATIONS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`<br>`thrillhousebot.notifications.webhook.secret` | HMAC-SHA256 key; when set, each request carries `X-Thrillhousebot-Signature-256: sha256=<hex>` computed over the exact request body. | string | _(none)_ |
| `NOTIFICATIONS_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT`<br>`thrillhousebot.notifications.webhook.timeout` | Per-attempt timeout (at most `60s`). | duration | `10s` |
| `NOTIFICATIONS_WEBHOOK_URL`<br>`thrillhousebot.notifications.webhook.url` | Receiver of review-outcome notifications; unset turns them off. Must be `https://`. Treated as a secret and logged only as scheme, host and port. See [Outgoing notifications](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#outgoing-notifications). | string | _(none)_ |

## `thrillhousebot.review`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ACK_REACTION_TIMEOUT`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ack-reaction-timeout` | Time limit on posting the 👀 reaction to a command; the reaction may land late. | duration | `3s` |
| `REVIEW_ADD_DOCS_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.add-docs-enabled` | Allow `/add-docs`, which posts generated docs for the changed symbols as committable suggestions. | boolean | `true` |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_REVIEW_AI_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ai-retry-base-delay-ms` | Base delay of the exponential retry backoff, in milliseconds. | integer | `2000` |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_REVIEW_AI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ai-timeout-seconds` | Client-side wait per streaming attempt, in seconds. Keep it at or above `AI_TIMEOUT` so a timed-out attempt does not leave a stream open at the provider. A second timeout fails the call. | integer | `300` |
| `AUTO_REVIEW_MIN_INTERVAL`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.auto-review-min-interval` | Minimum time between automatic reviews of one PR. Pushes inside the window are skipped, even on a new head (in memory, per replica). `/review` always runs. `0` reviews every push. | duration | `0` |
| `REVIEW_BLOCKING_STRICTNESS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.blocking-strictness` | Which findings request changes: `balanced`, `strict` or `lenient`. See [Blocking strictness](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#blocking-strictness). | string | `balanced` |
| `REVIEW_CI_GATING`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ci-gating` | How CI affects approval: `strict` holds approval while required CI is pending, failing or unreadable; `warn` approves and notes the CI state; `off` ignores CI. See [CI gating](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#ci-gating). | string | `strict` |
| `REVIEW_CONVERSATIONAL_REPLIES_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.conversational-replies-enabled` | Answer `@thrillhousebot` mentions in PR threads and replies to findings. | boolean | `true` |
| `REVIEW_DECLINE_RECHECK_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.decline-recheck-enabled` | Check a maintainer's decline against the reviewed code before recording the finding justified. See [Re-checking declines](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#re-checking-declines). `false` makes any reply final. | boolean | `true` |
| `REVIEW_DIMENSION_ROUTING_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.dimension-routing-enabled` | Give each review call only the review-dimension blocks its files can use, instead of all ten. See [Dimension routing](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#dimension-routing). | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_GENERATE_TESTS_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.generate-tests-enabled` | Allow `/generate-tests`, which posts proposed unit tests for the changed code as a comment to copy in. Nothing is committed. | boolean | `true` |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_REVIEW_IGNORED_FILES`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ignored-files` | Comma-separated gitignore-style globs never reviewed. A pattern without `/` matches at any depth (`*.lock`, `vendor`); one with `/` is anchored at the root (`docs/generated/**`); a trailing `/` means the directory's tree; `*` does not cross `/`. Write a `{a,b}` alternation as separate patterns. Setting it replaces the default list, which covers lockfiles, generated and minified code, sourcemaps, and build and vendor trees. Build manifests such as `pom.xml`, `package.json` and `Cargo.toml` are reviewed; every file the list excludes is named in the summary's scope note. | list | `**/package-lock.json`, `**/pnpm-lock.yaml`, `**/go.sum`, `**/*.lock`, `**/*.generated.*`, `**/*.pb.go`, `**/*_pb2.py`, `**/*.min.js`, `**/*.min.css`, `**/*.map`, `**/target/**`, `**/node_modules/**`, `**/dist/**`, `**/build/**`, `**/out/**`, `**/.next/**`, `**/vendor/**`, `**/__pycache__/**`, `**/.venv/**`, `**/bin/**`, `**/obj/**` |
| `REVIEW_IMPROVE_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.improve-enabled` | Allow `/improve`, which posts a whole-PR improvement pass as committable suggestions. | boolean | `true` |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_REVIEW_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.instructions-file` | Repository path of the review instructions file. | string | `.github/thrillhousebot.md` |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_REVIEW_MANUAL_TRIGGER_ALLOWED_LOGINS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.manual-trigger-allowed-logins` | Comma-separated logins allowed to run slash commands without write access. Does not apply to the `resolved` and `declined` directives. Unset means only users with write access. | list | _(none)_ |
| `MANUAL_TRIGGER_AUTH_TIMEOUT`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.manual-trigger-auth-timeout` | Time limit on the write-access check for a command. Slower answers from GitHub deny the command. | duration | `5s` |
| `REVIEW_MAX_AI_CALLS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.max-ai-calls` | Most AI calls per review (batch calls plus the summary call) and per command run (batch calls plus, for `/describe` and `/changelog`, the merge call). At `1`, a review that makes its review call has none left for the summary and posts a counts-only summary that says so. Verifier calls are not counted. | integer | `6` |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_REVIEW_MAX_AI_RETRIES`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.max-ai-retries` | Attempts per failed AI call. At most two may end in a timeout. | integer | `5` |
| `REVIEW_MAX_DIFF_LINES`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.max-diff-lines` | Line cap for single-call diff renders (replies, base comparison, reviews with budgeting off). Token-budgeted reviews and the batched commands ignore it. `0` disables it. | integer | `5000` |
| `REVIEW_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.max-input-tokens` | Input-token budget per call for reviews and the batched commands; larger PRs are split into batches. Capped by the model's `max-input-tokens` (see the per-model settings). `0` disables budgeting. | integer | `48000` |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_REVIEW_MAX_REVIEW_COMMENTS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.max-review-comments` | Most inline comments per review; the rest are listed in the summary. | integer | `50` |
| `REVIEW_MAX_TOKENS_PER_REVIEW`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.max-tokens-per-review` | Most tokens one review may use across all its calls, as the provider reports them, retries and the summary call included. Once reached, no further call is made: the remaining batches are named as not reviewed, the summary degrades to counts only, and the findings already paid for are kept. Reviews only. `0` disables it. | integer | `0` |
| `REVIEW_OUTPUT_BUFFER_TOKENS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.output-buffer-tokens` | Tokens reserved from the input budget for the response. A model with `separate-output-budget` set reserves nothing. | integer | `8192` |
| `THRILLHOUSEBOT_REVIEW_REPO_CONFIG_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.repo-config-enabled` | Read `.github/thrillhousebot.yml` from each repository (extra ignore globs, path-scoped rules, coverage artifact). See [Repository configuration](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#repository-configuration). | boolean | `true` |
| `REVIEW_RESPONSE_REPAIR_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.response-repair-enabled` | When a review or summary answer is not valid review JSON, send only that answer and the parser's error in one small call and ask for the same content in the required shape, before resending the whole prompt. Also asks again for the walkthrough's file summaries when the summary answer wrote them as a string. See [AI call budget](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#ai-call-budget). | boolean | `true` |
| `REVIEW_SUMMARY_VERIFICATION_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.summary-verification-enabled` | Check the summary's sentences, walkthrough rows and diagram against the diff and the findings, and remove what they contradict. One more call per review. See [AI call budget](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#ai-call-budget). | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_TOKEN_SAFETY_MARGIN`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.token-safety-margin` | Fraction of the input budget actually used, to absorb token-estimate error. | number | `0.9` |
| `REVIEW_VERIFIER_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.verifier-enabled` | Run a second, skeptical pass that re-checks each finding against the diff and drops or downgrades what it cannot confirm. See [AI call budget](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#ai-call-budget). | boolean | `true` |

## `thrillhousebot.review.ci-context`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REVIEW_CI_CONTEXT_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ci-context.enabled` | Include the checks that had already failed on the head commit. See [CI-failure context](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#ci-failure-context). | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_CI_CONTEXT_INCLUDE_LOGS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ci-context.include-logs` | Also include the last 30 lines of up to two failing GitHub Actions job logs. Ignored unless `REVIEW_CI_CONTEXT_ENABLED` is on. | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_CI_CONTEXT_MAX_CHARS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ci-context.max-chars` | Character cap on the CI section (500–20000). | integer | `4000` |

## `thrillhousebot.review.diagram`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REVIEW_DIAGRAM_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.diagram.enabled` | Add a Mermaid control-flow diagram to the summary. | boolean | `false` |

## `thrillhousebot.review.follow-up-summary`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REVIEW_FOLLOW_UP_SUMMARY_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.follow-up-summary.enabled` | Include new, resolved and still-open counts in the follow-up review outcome, naming closed findings once. No separate delta comment; nothing is added when no finding is raised or closed. | boolean | `false` |

## `thrillhousebot.review.labels`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REVIEW_LABELS_ALLOW_CREATE`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.labels.allow-create` | Allow creating a suggested label that does not exist yet. | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_LABELS_APPLY`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.labels.apply` | Add the labels to the PR instead of suggesting them in a comment. | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_LABELS_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.labels.enabled` | Suggest PR labels. See [PR labels](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#pr-labels). | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_LABELS_MAX`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.labels.max-labels` | Most labels applied or suggested per PR. | integer | `3` |

## `thrillhousebot.review.large-pr-nudge`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REVIEW_LARGE_PR_NUDGE_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.large-pr-nudge.enabled` | On a large PR whose review opened no inline finding and left no earlier finding open, add a note to the summary pointing at `/review` and `/improve`. No extra AI call; the verdict is unchanged. | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_LARGE_PR_NUDGE_MIN_CHANGED_LINES`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.large-pr-nudge.min-changed-lines` | Added plus deleted lines at which a PR counts as large; either test is enough. `0` turns this test off. | integer | `1000` |
| `REVIEW_LARGE_PR_NUDGE_MIN_FILES`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.large-pr-nudge.min-files` | Changed files (ignored files included) at which a PR counts as large. `0` turns this test off. | integer | `20` |

## `thrillhousebot.review.learnings`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REVIEW_LEARNINGS_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.learnings.enabled` | Remember maintainer declines and `/remember` conventions per repository and show them to later reviews. See [Review learnings](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#review-learnings). Startup fails if this is on while `REVIEW_DECLINE_RECHECK_ENABLED` is off. | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_LEARNINGS_MAX_PER_REPO`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.learnings.max-per-repo` | Active learnings one repository may hold (1–1000). At the cap a new learning is refused, not evicted; two captures racing at the cap can each add one. | integer | `100` |
| `REVIEW_LEARNINGS_PROMPT_MAX_CHARS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.learnings.prompt-max-chars` | Character cap on the learnings section (500–20000). | integer | `3000` |
| `REVIEW_LEARNINGS_PROMPT_MAX_ITEMS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.learnings.prompt-max-items` | Most learnings in one review prompt (1–50). | integer | `10` |

## `thrillhousebot.review.patch-coverage`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REVIEW_PATCH_COVERAGE_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.patch-coverage.enabled` | Tell the review which added lines the repository's own coverage report never ran. Needs `coverage-artifact` in `.github/thrillhousebot.yml` (see [Repository configuration](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#repository-configuration)). | boolean | `false` |

## `thrillhousebot.review.security-scan`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REVIEW_SECRET_SCAN_ENTROPY_THRESHOLD`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.security-scan.entropy-threshold` | Minimum Shannon entropy (bits per character) for the generic credential-assignment rule; the known token formats ignore it. Must be in (0, 8]. | number | `3.5` |
| `REVIEW_IAC_SCAN_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.security-scan.iac-enabled` | Scan added lines for risky infrastructure-as-code settings (Terraform, Kubernetes, CloudFormation, Dockerfiles). | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_SECRET_SCAN_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.security-scan.secrets-enabled` | Scan added lines for leaked credentials (provider token formats, private keys, JWTs, assignments). See [Security scan](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#security-scan). | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_SECURITY_SCAN_SKIPPED_FILES`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.security-scan.skipped-files` | Comma-separated globs the scan skips on top of the review's ignore list, for fixtures and snapshots where token-shaped sample data is expected. | list | `**/fixtures/**`, `**/__fixtures__/**`, `**/testdata/**`, `**/test-data/**`, `**/__snapshots__/**`, `**/*.snap` |

## `thrillhousebot.review.ticket-context`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REVIEW_TICKET_CONTEXT_ENABLED`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ticket-context.enabled` | Include the issues the PR links and list unaddressed acceptance criteria in the summary. See [Linked-issue context](https://github.com/devops-thiago/ThrillhouseBot#linked-issue-context). | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_TICKET_CONTEXT_FROM_BRANCH`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ticket-context.from-branch` | Also take an issue number from the head branch name (`issue-57`, `fix/57-short-name`) when nothing else links one. | boolean | `false` |
| `REVIEW_TICKET_CONTEXT_MAX_CHARS`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ticket-context.max-chars` | Character cap on the linked-issue section (1000–20000). | integer | `6000` |
| `REVIEW_TICKET_CONTEXT_MAX_ISSUES`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ticket-context.max-issues` | Linked issues read per review (1–5); once this many are read, later references are ignored. | integer | `3` |
| `REVIEW_TICKET_CONTEXT_PROVIDER`<br>`thrillhousebot.review.ticket-context.provider` | Where linked issues are read from. Only `github` exists. | string | `github` |

## `thrillhousebot.webhook`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WEBHOOK_DEDUP_TTL`<br>`thrillhousebot.webhook.dedup-ttl` | How long a webhook delivery id (`X-GitHub-Delivery`) is remembered, to ignore GitHub redeliveries instead of reviewing twice. Kept in memory, per replica. | duration | `24h` |

## `thrillhousebot.webhook.triggers`

| Variable | Description | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WEBHOOK_BASE_BRANCHES`<br>`thrillhousebot.webhook.triggers.base-branches` | Comma-separated globs; auto-review only PRs whose base branch matches one (`main,release/*`). `*` does not cross `/`; use `**` for that. Unset means every base branch. | list | _(none)_ |
| `WEBHOOK_EXCLUDED_LABELS`<br>`thrillhousebot.webhook.triggers.excluded-labels` | Comma-separated labels; skip auto-review of PRs carrying any (case-insensitive exact match). Wins over `WEBHOOK_REQUIRED_LABELS`. | list | _(none)_ |
| `WEBHOOK_IGNORED_BASE_BRANCHES`<br>`thrillhousebot.webhook.triggers.ignored-base-branches` | Comma-separated globs; skip auto-review of PRs whose base branch matches one (`dependabot/**`). Wins over `WEBHOOK_BASE_BRANCHES`. | list | _(none)_ |
| `WEBHOOK_REQUIRED_LABELS`<br>`thrillhousebot.webhook.triggers.required-labels` | Comma-separated labels; auto-review only PRs carrying at least one (case-insensitive exact match). Unset means no label is required. | list | _(none)_ |
| `WEBHOOK_SKIP_DRAFTS`<br>`thrillhousebot.webhook.triggers.skip-drafts` | Do not auto-review drafts; the PR is reviewed once marked ready (`ready_for_review`). | boolean | `false` |
